title: Small words, big effect: particles
description: Hear the attitude behind przecież, chyba, niby, akurat and bynajmniej.

blocks.text: Particles such as przecież, chyba, niby and akurat carry the speaker's attitude rather than facts. Przecież appeals to something the listener should already know. Chyba marks a guess, and in Chyba żartujesz it expresses disbelief. Niby signals doubt about what is claimed. Akurat means precisely, but said alone it is a sarcastic denial. Bynajmniej means not at all and is often confused with przynajmniej, at least.

blocks.note: Przecież: you should know this already.

blocks.text: Niby tak, ale nie jestem przekonana.
blocks.translation: Supposedly yes, but I am not convinced.
Just at that moment the phone rang.

blocks.note: Said alone, it is a sarcastic denial.

blocks.text: Nie jestem bynajmniej przeciwny tej propozycji.
blocks.translation: I am by no means against this proposal.

lines.speaker: Kasia
lines.text: Gdzie są klucze? Przecież leżały na stole.
lines.translation: Where are the keys? But they were on the table.

lines.speaker: Piotr
lines.translation: You probably left them in the car.

lines.speaker: Kasia
lines.text: Akurat! Nigdy ich tam nie zostawiam.
lines.translation: Yeah, right! I never leave them there.

lines.speaker: Piotr
lines.text: Niby nie, a w zeszłym tygodniu?
